page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Page number top right, running head top centre. Below the text: signature "T 4" at centre foot, catchword "pretium" at right.

main_text.l: Principia dignosci certo nequeunt, neque Conclu-
siones
ex iis rite colligi, si Adjumenta modo me-
morata neglectui habeantur. Et sane si Sociniani,
cum aliis Hæreticis, immunes essent à Philautia ac
Præjudicio, veritatemque sincero Amore colerent,
istiusmodi errores tam arctis amplexibus nunquam
foverent, & tam obstinate tuerentur; mediis om-
nibus retegendi eos, interea, aut superbe contemp-
tis aut saltem crasse neglectis. Interim tamen, bene
se habet, quod ad hoc opus judicandi imprimis
requirat illustrationem Spiritus Sancti, cujus duc-
tum Ratio sequi debeat. Hunc enim qui sequitur,
neque in ignorantiæ tenebris ambulabit, neque in
devias errorum ambages se abduci patietur. Hoc
autem lumen atque hunc Ducem, quicunque de Cœ-
lo sibi dari velit, necesse est, ut (Impedimentis re-
cte judicandi procul amotis) oculos suos aperiat
ad hoc Cœleste lumen intromittendum, & Ducem
præeuntem sedulo sequatur. Alioquin, hoc Divi-
num Auxilium vel omnino negabitur ei, vel in-
cassum dabitur. Neque enim Deus hujusmodi Do-
num aut conferre in invitos solet, aut apud Ingra-
tos & Ignavos conservare.

page.notes: Running head "sana" is read as "sana"; the italic letter is slightly unclear. "Concessa[?]": the word on the line before the catchword is smudged and reads roughly as "Concessa". The § 137 paragraph ends mid-sentence at the last full line, and "pretium" is the catchword. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side is visible in the lower half and was not transcribed. Printed "Ratio" is in italics in §136; the "9." and "10." numbers follow the § numbers as printed.
